decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 28 November 2005 the single storey detached out building, for use as a gym, measuring 7 metres long, 9.15 metres wide and 3.98 metres high to top of ridged roof was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the 	following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.  
Condition : 2 - Informative: 
The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwelling house known as 528 Great West Road and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be 	used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a detached single storey gym/ outbuilding to rear of garden of house.
